parts.title: The Departure
parts.text: Katya's family had saved for three years to **embark** on the steamship that would carry them across the ocean. Standing on the crowded pier, she felt a rush of **anticipation** mixed with fear. They could only afford **steerage**, the lowest passenger deck, far beneath the glittering cabins where wealthy travelers slept. "We **aspire** to something better than this," he told her, "and one day we will reach it."

parts.title: Below Deck
parts.text: The bunks were **cramped**, stacked three high with barely room to roll over. Katya soon met Emeka, a boy from a fishing village, and Lucas, who was traveling alone to join his uncle. At night the three traded stories about their **ancestry**, the grandparents and great-grandparents whose lives had shaped their own. When a storm tossed the ship for two days, Lucas felt **disoriented**, unable to tell which way was up in the darkness. The **uncertainty** in every whisper was louder than the wind: would the new country welcome them?

parts.title: The Harbor
parts.text: On the eighteenth morning, land rose out of the mist. An **inspector** in a gray coat came aboard and examined every passenger for signs of illness. Because several children had fevers, the ship was held in **quarantine** for four more days, anchored within sight of the city but forbidden to land. Katya stared at rows of chimneys and lit windows, each one a **dwelling** where a family was safe and warm. Emeka folded his arms and promised to **strive** every day until his own family owned one.

parts.title: A New Chapter
parts.text: When the fevers finally passed, the three friends walked down the gangway together. Katya realized that courage is mostly a habit of taking the next step while you are still afraid.

definitions.meaning1: A period of isolation for people or animals that might carry a disease, used to keep it from spreading. Example: The travelers spent a week in quarantine before they were allowed into the city.
definitions.meaning2: To keep a person or group apart from others to stop an illness from spreading. Example: Doctors had to quarantine the sick passengers on a separate deck.

secretPassage.instructions: Read the passage below. Fill in each blank with the correct vocabulary word from the word bank.
secretPassage.passage:
Years later, Emeka told his grandchildren about the day his family decided to _(1)_ on the long voyage. They had little money, so they traveled in _(2)_, the lowest deck of the ship. The bunks were _(3)_, and a storm left many passengers feeling _(4)_ and seasick. Everyone shared a deep _(5)_ about what lay ahead, but there was joyful _(6)_ each time someone spotted a gull and guessed that land was near.

When the ship reached the harbor, a stern _(7)_ boarded to check each person's health. Sick passengers had to remain in _(8)_ for several days. Emeka often spoke of his _(9)_ and the proud traditions of the people who came before him. As a boy, he had dared to _(10)_ to become a builder, and he worked to _(11)_ toward that goal every single day. "Now," he said, tapping the walls of the house he had built himself, "this is the _(12)_ I once only imagined."
